Name: Dexter's Furniture Store
Author: AmuTsukiyomi
Description:
I'm not a fan of blood/gore in the slightest, but for some reason the idea of making a furniture mod that would allow people to make their farmhouse (or if you have the Furniture Anywhere mod, all of Pelican Town and Stardew Valley) look like it's inhabited by a serial killer was hilarious to me.  So I made it.

Might later add more things, but for now I'm satisfied with what I have...

[color=#e06666]EDIT 11/28/18:  I've added about ten more items and improved the appearance of anything that should've had a shadow before and didn't.[/color]

[size=4][b][s]WARNING (11/28/18 11:55pm): I've found that [i]any[/i] furniture I place CANNOT be picked back up or removed using tools.  I do not know why.  This goes for vanilla furniture as well.[/s][color=#6d9eeb] [/color][color=#e69138]PLAYTONYMOUS IS AWESOME AND MANAGED TO FIX THIS ISSUE IN THE MOST RECENT VERSION OF CUSTOM FURNITURE ANYWHERE (or so I've heard; been having issues with my SDV game so I haven't gotten to check it for myself as of yet)[/color][/b][/size]

Requires SMAPI, Playtonymous' PyTK and Custom Furniture mods, and if you plan on putting furniture everywhere Entoarox Framework, Furniture Anywhere, and Custom Furniture Anywhere.

Just drop the folder into the Furniture folder within Custom Furniture and you're all set to murder-ify the valley to your heart's content!

[color=#cc0000][b]ASK TO USE MY SPRITES for other stuff, otherwise the answer is a default [i][u]ABSOLUTELY NO.

[/u][/i][/b][/color][color=#d9d2e9][b]If you liked this mod, maybe check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3139]Dexter's Holiday Decorations[/url][/b][/color]

Downloads.Description: Now with less curly quotes and the same level of horror as 1.1.0 for the locals!
